sloka: सो ऽर्थं विदित्वा सकलं तस्य राज्ञो यथागतम् ।सर्वा एव स्त्रियस्ताश्च बभाषे मुनिपुङ्गवः ।। ७.८८.२१ ॥
transliteration: so 'rthaṁ viditvā sakalaṁ tasya rājño yathāgatam ।sarvā eva striyastāśca babhāṣe munipuṅgavaḥ ।। 7.88.21 ॥

translations.english: Having understood the entire situation of that king as it had occurred, the foremost among sages then spoke to all those women.
